meta.scope: India 13 + Pakistan 3 records, all under_review on import (NEVER verified on import). 3 records HELD: SB-PK-2 (truncated source URL, unverifiable citation), SB-PK-3 (elemental-P vs P2O5 ambiguity + Scribd host), J-IN-3 (seed-production jute - must never enter the calculator as a fibre dose). Coffee/jute PK: genuine gaps (no commercial cultivation), nothing populated - do NOT borrow Indian doses. Verified 2026-10-06 (16/16 recommendations, 7/7 windows; import fidelity vs research files; CF-IN-6 K2O=173 flagged as outlier but faithful to official CCRI dose).
meta.regionMapping: Research 'in-pb' -> reuse 'in-punjab'; 'pk-pb' -> reuse 'pk-punjab'; 'pk-kp' -> reuse 'pk-kpk' (base seed slug for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa); 'in-hr' -> reuse 'in-haryana'. 'in' (national, coffee) -> regionSlug null for recommendations, no windows (perennial plantation crop). New regions created: in-tn (Tamil Nadu), in-wb (West Bengal).
meta.notesConvention: FertilizerRecommendation has no notes column (batches 1-4 pattern). Caveats mapped to: soilContext (K-conditionality - batch-5 precedent: base K2O normalized to 0, conditional amount in notes), micronutrients (S/B/Zn), applicationMethod (trial-status, variety-specificity, conflict flags), applicationTiming (split schedules, sowing detail), Source.notes (oxide-form caveat). isPrimary: official PoP records only (PAU canola/sugar-beet, CRIJAF-preferred jute J-IN-1, all 6 CCRI coffee records); trial/demo records stay non-primary. Tie-break among multiple primaries is createdAt-asc (seed insertion order).
